## Technical Stack
- Frontend: Angular (standalone components, signals, SSR), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, RxJS, Tailwind CSS
- Graphics & motion: GSAP (ScrollTrigger, timelines), Lenis, WebGL, Canvas 2D
- Backend & tooling: C#, ASP.NET Web API, Node.js, Python, SQL, Git, Netlify
- Practices: responsive design, web performance, accessibility, algorithmic problem solving
